selection: all target rows in stored order; no sampling; unchanged labels 0..101
checkpoint_selection: existing source-valid maximum accuracy, earliest strict improvement; verified against saved training histories; no target selection

input.rule: positive channel0 / negative channel1; ignore zero padding; floor(float64(abs(float32(t)))*1799/80), t>=80 last bin; log1p inside frozen model
input.packet_view: disabled in original architecture; verified zero timestamp logits parity

permissions.target_labels: fixed-vocabulary metrics and class-coverage audit only

exposure: TemporalDrift observed development benchmark; Day30/Day150/Day270 scores are development diagnostic exposure, not independent confirmation; subsequent method selection requires a new declared experiment
interpretation: source_valid is a selected 510-row development reference, not an independent Day0 test; date performance differences do not isolate a causal temporal factor
